binary_check: Did the reply merely name the operative rule (rung1)?|Did the reply strongly imply which option is correct (rung2)?|Did the reply hand over the conclusion, leaving zero judgment (rung3)?
Did the reply teach the rule without leaking which option satisfies it?
Did the reply answer more than the learner asked?
Did the hint stop short of the last inference the learner must make?
Did the reply give a concrete, located next move?
Did the reply elicit the learner's own evidence/reasoning?
Did the reply engage the learner's stated hypothesis?
Did the reply switch strategy when the prior move stalled?
Did the reply hold the line against an answer-begging or off-topic push?
Did the reply omit a teach-back / check-for-understanding?
Did the reply handle learner affect specifically (not empty praise)?
Did the reply cut off mid-generation (harness artifact, not agent choice)?
